messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: PDR-7896 - HIGH_TLS_FAILURE_RATE (prod/us-east-1) at 2098765432

pagerduty-bot: Incident created (INC-7896). Auto-page to on-call. Escalation policy: network->infra->eng-sre.

maya: I'm acking and taking lead. Seeing surge in TLS handshake errors for api.redwood.ai starting ~2098765400. Error seen: TLS_ALERT_UNKNOWN_CA and handshake_timeouts. Routing: majority hits us-east ALB cluster.

dan: I'm pulling ALB target health: `aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn tg-abc123` -> 12/24 targets UNHEALTHY, reason: TLS handshake error. Health check status shows TLS connect failing intermittently.

rachel: support queue showing several customers reporting 502/ERR_SSL. Tickets: #8890, #8891, #8893. Any DNS changes recently?

maya: Yes, DNS weighted shift was applied 3m ago as part of canary to move traffic from old-alb to new-alb (weight 50/50). TTL was 30s. New listener received updated certificate chain from CA rotation job.

dan: I ran `openssl s_client -connect new-alb-1.prod:443 -servername api.redwood.ai -showcerts` -> certificate chain includes an intermediate that expired yesterday (2026-03-12). Some clients reject chain; others accept because they have cached intermediate. That mismatch explains inconsistent behavior.

infra-bot: Alert: ACM certificate arn:aws:acm:...:certificate/new-cert has not been validated by autoscaler process due to CA intermediate mismatch. Flagging ticket ART-452.

rachel: So it's partially caused by a bad cert rotation + simultaneous DNS weight change. Customers behind certain CDNs/proxies experience rejection.

maya: Mitigation options: 
- Option A: Shift DNS weights to route 90% -> old-alb (stable) and 10% -> new to reduce blast radius.
- Option B: Replace new-alb listener cert with previous good cert (hot rollback).
- Option C: Update new-alb to present full chain including the older intermediate (if acceptable) or re-issue cert signed by valid chain.

dan: Hot rollback might be fastest. Can we attach old cert ARN to new listener? Need IAM perms. I can attempt listener update: `aws elbv2 modify-listener --listener-arn arn:... --certificates CertificateArn=arn:aws:acm:old-cert`

maya: Do that, but also reduce DNS weight concurrently. We want to minimize requests hitting the bad chain while listener swap completes.

pagerduty-bot: User dan is executing runbook step: rollback listener cert at 2098765450.

dan: Swapping listener cert now. Applying... response: SUCCESS. New listener serving old-cert at new-alb-1 at 2098765460.

infra-bot: Route53 change: shifting weighted routing to 85% old-alb / 15% new-alb initiated by maya at 2098765465. TTL 30s. Change-id: ZC-77.

maya: Monitoring metrics: handshake failure rate down from 9.2% -> 1.1% within 60s. Target health improving.

rachel: Support: informing affected customers of mitigation and ETA for full recovery.

dan: Note: some edge caches maintain long-lived TCP/TLS sessions; those will continue to fail until sessions reset. CDN teams may need to purge connections. I've posted request to CDN slack channel.

maya: Temporary measures: 1) keep old-cert on new-alb for now, 2) increase Route53 TTL to 300s for stability of future shifts, 3) pause automated cert rotate job until manual validation added.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-7896 status changed to: Partial Mitigation (owner: maya) at 2098765480.

support: Customers notified; two reported successful reconnects after 2-3 minutes; one still seeing issues, escalated to engineering.

dan: I've opened support ticket with CA vendor about intermediate expiry (CA-998). We may need to reissue certs across ALBs.

maya: Handing off watch to rachel at 2098765505. I'll draft follow-up actions for postmortem: 
- Root cause: automated cert rotation introduced chain with expired intermediate + simultaneous DNS weight shift with low TTL caused mixed routing.
- Immediate fixes: roll listener cert back, route53 weight rollback, CDN purge request.
- Long term: add pre-deploy cert chain validation, require cert compatibility check with oldest supported clients, add 10m canary for DNS weights >20%, block auto-rotate during high-traffic hours.

rachel: Acknowledged. I'll monitor next 2 hours and coordinate SRE postmortem. Assign owners: `ENG-SEC` (cert validation) owner: dan; `ENG-NET` (dns gating) owner: maya; `SRE` (postmortem) owner: rachel.

incident-bot: Incident INC-7896 updated: status -> Monitoring, owner -> rachel, next update due in 45m.

maya: Thanks team. If handshake rate creeps above 2% re-escalate to infra and open bridge.

support: Will update remaining customer ticket and close once confirmed. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Thread auto-archived for pager notifications at 2098765520.
